scope: Original complete 0x4a0130 through its epilogue with real terrain height/normal queries, transforms, contact-axis helper, cross/normalization and both wheel-radius offsets/resamples and contact-height differences, then heading/roll-dependent probe points and terrain resamples with pinned Wine 11 D3DRMVectorRotate. Main-substep integration and whole-bike trajectories excluded.
